pattern: Labelled region with a heading and header buttons; collapse follows the WAI-ARIA APG Disclosure pattern; maximize follows the APG modal Dialog pattern (top layer through the Popover API).

roles.role: region (set unless the host already has another role); dialog while maximized

aria.value: id of the title text (region and dialog name)
Localized 'Collapse {title}' / 'Expand {title}', 'Maximize {title}' / 'Restore {title}', 'Remove {title}', or the custom action label

keyboard.action: Moves through the header buttons and body content in DOM order.
Toggles the body (aria-expanded); emits aui-toggle. Focus stays on the button.
Maximizes into a modal dialog; focus moves to the restore button and is trapped inside the widget; page scroll is locked.
Restores the widget (topmost overlay first); focus returns to the maximize button.

focus: Header buttons show a focus-ring-width outline in color-focus-ring. Re-rendering keeps focus on the same action. Maximize moves focus to the restore button; restore returns it to the maximize button.
notes: The region is named by the visible title; action names include the title, so several widgets on one page stay distinguishable.
Collapse hides the body with display: none, so hidden content is removed from the accessibility tree and tab order.
Maximized, outside pointer presses do not restore the widget; Escape and the restore button do.
The collapse button is not shown while maximized.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
The collapse button has no aria-controls (the body is every host child except the header).
Many widgets on a page create many region landmarks; give hosts another role (for example role=group) when that is too noisy.
